exposure: Pain management technique (epidural analgesia, intravenous fentanyl infusion, intravenous tramadol boluses)
cohort: 12 pregnant women with acute pancreatitis at Mayo Hospital over a 6-year period.
finding: Epidural analgesia was more effective than intravenous fentanyl infusion or intravenous tramadol boluses for pain relief in pregnant women with acute pancreatitis.
mod_finding: The study suggests the possibility of using the same epidural catheter for labor analgesia and anesthesia during cesarean section in women who received epidural analgesia for acute pancreatitis during pregnancy.
